desc: Identify the structural reduction: direct for disjoint, one common disjoint for containment, and for crossing either one common disjoint or one interval right of the early endpoint plus one left of the late endpoint.
Implement and locally validate the O(N+Q) direct case-analysis solution in Python using P[x]=min W_i with R_i<x and S[x]=min W_i with L_i>x, strict inequalities, large INF, and fast I/O.
Finalize the submitted code so it reads stdin, writes stdout, and contains no hardcoded sample tests.
Run public sample tests and confirm both samples pass.
